_comment: Board database for pedalflash. 'methods' lists what the HARDWARE supports; the first is the default. mcu = CubeMX part name (used only when a project has no .cproject).

boards.name: WeAct STM32F4 Core Board (STM32F405RGT6, USB-C)
boards.dfu_entry: USB-C plugged in: hold the B0 button, tap NR (reset), release B0. The board then shows up as 'STM32 BOOTLOADER' (0483:df11).
notes: Start with firmware/STM32F405_WeAct/blinky: LED PB2 blinks 1 Hz (5 Hz while KEY/PC13 is held).
SWD alternative: ST-LINK on the 3V3 / DIO / CLK / GND header.

boards.name: WeAct STM32H723VGT6 Core Board (550 MHz, 564 KB RAM, USB-C)
boards.dfu_entry: USB-C plugged in: hold BOOT0, tap reset, release BOOT0.
notes: Not tested: board entry only, no ported firmware yet (the full ZombiSS chain would fit: 564 KB RAM, 550 MHz).

boards.name: GuitarML STM32 Guitar Pedal (STM32H7B0VB + CS4270)
notes: No USB on this PCB (PA11 drives an LED), so USB-DFU is impossible: flash with an ST-LINK V3 (it plugs into USB) on the 10-pin JTAG header.
Pedal must also be powered from its 9 V supply while flashing.
If the pedal runs after flashing but not after a power cycle, set the boot option bytes once (BOOT_CM7_ADD0/ADD1 = 0x0800, see the GuitarPedalSTM32 README).

boards.name: Phil's Lab InfiniFX Reloaded (STM32H7B0VB + CS4270, USB-C)
boards.dfu_entry: Hold BOOT0 high (BOOT button / jumper, if your board revision has one) while plugging in USB, then release. 'pedalflash doctor' should then list 0483:df11.
notes: USB OTG HS is on PA11/PA12, so the ROM DFU bootloader can be used if BOOT0 is reachable on your board revision (not verified on hardware).

boards.name: WeAct BlackPill STM32F411CE
boards.dfu_entry: Hold BOOT0, tap NRST, release BOOT0 (USB-C plugged in).

boards.name: WeAct BlackPill STM32F401CC
boards.dfu_entry: Hold BOOT0, tap NRST, release BOOT0 (USB-C plugged in).

boards.name: BluePill STM32F103C8
notes: The F103 ROM bootloader has no USB DFU (UART only): use an ST-LINK on the SWD pins.

boards.name: Electrosmith Daisy Seed (STM32H750IB, internal flash)
boards.dfu_entry: Hold BOOT, tap RESET, release BOOT.
notes: Only the 128 KB internal-flash layout is handled; QSPI/bootloader apps need Electrosmith's own tooling.
